rows.commentary: 6.5: Gurnoor Brar drops it short outside off, and Tim Seifert reads the length instantly to pummel a pull wide of mid-wicket for four before sharp words fly between the two.
6.6: Gurnoor Brar delivers short of length outside off, and Tim Seifert camps on the back foot to punch it crisply straight to the fielder at point.
7.1: Arshdeep Singh fires a length ball down the leg side, allowing Will Young to glance it away toward deep backward square-leg for a single.
7.2: Arshdeep Singh bangs it short and down leg, leaving Tim Seifert to miss his flick while the umpire strangely denies the wide appeal.
7.3: Arshdeep Singh squares up Tim Seifert on the back foot, drawing a thick edge that dies on Rohit as he tumbles forward at fourth slip.
7.4: Arshdeep Singh digs it in short outside leg, and Tim Seifert watches in relief as the extra bounce sails harmlessly over the timber.
7.5: Tim Seifert marches down the pitch to Arshdeep Singh, dragging a length ball off the inside half toward deep mid-on for a comfortable single.
7.6: Arshdeep Singh hurls a back-of-a-length delivery angling away outside off, beating Will Young's sweeping back-foot punch past the outside edge.
8.1: Auqib Nabi pushes a fullish delivery outside off, and Tim Seifert strides forward to drive it straight to cover after losing his bottom hand.
8.2: Auqib Nabi offers width outside off on a fuller length, and Tim Seifert reaches out to launch it high over long-off for a maximum.
8.3: Auqib Nabi keeps it short of length, and Tim Seifert pounces early onto the back foot to swipe a pull past the diving mid-wicket fielder.
8.4: Auqib Nabi pitches on a good length outside off, and Tim Seifert steps forward to drive on the up straight to cover-point.
8.5: Auqib Nabi digs it in short outside the tramlines, allowing Tim Seifert to drop back and punch a comfortable single into the deep backward point region.

8.6: Auqib Nabi errs with width on a short length, and Will Young ruthlessly pivots backward to slash it through the gap between cover and cover-point for a boundary, compounding the bowler's misery after a fifteen-run over as Rohit Sharma offers some consolation words.

9.1: Arshdeep Singh darts one short and down the leg side, catching Tim Seifert's thigh pad as he attempts to flick, racing past Ishan Kishan's despairing dive to the fine leg fence for four leg byes.
9.2: Arshdeep Singh delivers short of a length on middle, and Tim Seifert drops back to work it away for a single, carving out his maiden half-century in this format with a lift of the bat.
9.3: Arshdeep Singh offers a full delivery outside off, and Will Young strides forward to push it toward Shreyas at mid-off, completing an uncomplicated single despite a brief fumble in the field.
9.4: Dot ball from Arshdeep Singh to Tim Seifert.
20.3: Axar Patel delivers flat on a length outside off, and Finn Allen drops back to punch it straight to extra-cover.
20.4: Axar Patel keeps it flat and back of a length outside off, allowing Finn Allen to rock back and force a single to long-on.
20.5: Axar Patel tosses it full outside off, and Will Young steps forward to drive firmly toward long-off.
20.6: Axar Patel lands a good length outside off, prompting Finn Allen onto the back foot to punch it out to sweeper cover.
21.1: Auqib Nabi digs it in short just outside off, and Finn Allen swats a powerful pull over square leg to race away for four.
21.2: Auqib Nabi angles a short delivery back into off stump, forcing Finn Allen to check his back-foot defense toward mid-wicket for a quick run.
21.3: Auqib Nabi tests him with a short ball outside off, and Will Young swivels to pull it away toward deep backward square-leg.
21.4: Auqib Nabi bangs it short outside off, Finn Allen punches to cover where Shreyas dives left and fumbles, letting them scamper a single.
21.5: Auqib Nabi sends down a sharp short ball outside off, and Will Young wisely ducks his head to let it pass.
21.6: Auqib Nabi pushes it short outside off, and Will Young stays back to pull it firmly toward the stationed deep square leg.
22.1: Axar Patel floats it on off, and Will Young drops to one knee to exquisitely sweep it behind square on the leg-side for four.
22.2: Axar Patel drifts it full into off stump, prompting Will Young right forward into a defensive block.
22.3: Axar Patel darts a flat, round-arm delivery on a good length to off stump, and Will Young dead-bats it into the pitch with minimal fuss.
22.4: Axar Patel drifts a slower, fuller ball wide of off, allowing Will Young to stride forward and punch the drive out to the sweeper cover fielder.
22.5: Axar Patel serves up a tempting, full delivery outside off, and Finn Allen clears the front leg to launch it monstrously straight over the sightscreen for a maximum.
22.6: Axar Patel hurries a quick, short delivery into middle, cramping Finn Allen who retreats onto the back foot to work it towards mid-wicket.
23.1: Kuldeep Yadav is greeted by Will Young, who works the ball neatly away towards the fine leg region to pick up a couple of comfortable runs.
33.4: Kuldeep Yadav lands a good length ball turning into off and middle, trapping Will Young on the back foot for a defensive block before diving sharply to his right to deny the single.
33.5: Will Young executes a gorgeous premeditated reverse-sweep off a full toss on middle from Kuldeep Yadav, lofting it cleanly over backward point for four.
33.6: Coming down the track to a full delivery from Kuldeep Yadav, Will Young flicks it away smoothly towards deep backward square-leg for a single.
34.1: Axar Patel holds the length back outside off as Will Young steps out, forcing the batter to lean back and guide it toward backward point.
34.2: Will Young gets forward to a full, curving delivery from Axar Patel, driving it firmly down to long-on to collect a comfortable single.
34.3: Michael Bracewell flashes hard at a full ball outside off from Axar Patel, inducing a thick outside edge that races away before the substitute Kushagra hunts it down to limit the damage to two.
34.4: Michael Bracewell works a good length delivery sliding down leg off his back foot to fine-leg, where Nabi tidily restricts them to a single.
34.5: Creating room against a flat, good length ball from Axar Patel, Will Young cuts it away sharply to deep point for a well-earned run.
34.6: Axar Patel finishes an exemplary spell by coming round the wicket to pitch on a length on middle, defended solidly to mid-wicket before joining a conference with Naman Dhir and Kohli.
35.1: Will Young misses another premeditated reverse-sweep against Kuldeep Yadav, watching the ball deflect off his pad toward short fine after pitching outside leg.
35.2: Kuldeep Yadav delivers a flat, good length ball down leg which Will Young nudges off his back foot just past the left of short fine for a single.
35.3: Michael Bracewell steps into a nicely looped delivery on the stumps from Kuldeep Yadav, meeting it full to drive down to long-on for a brisk run.
35.4: Kuldeep Yadav serves it full on off, and Will Young steps down the track to loft it cleanly over long-off into the stands.
35.5: Kuldeep Yadav drops another full delivery on off, which Will Young pushes forward to silly-point before denying a single called by Michael Bracewell.
35.6: Kuldeep Yadav strays full down leg, allowing Will Young to drop to one knee and sweep it briskly to the deep backward square-leg boundary.
36.1: Naman Dhir delivers slower and fuller outside off, inviting Michael Bracewell forward to stroke it wide of sweeper cover for an effortless couple.
36.2: Naman Dhir tosses it full outside off, and Michael Bracewell drives it toward deep extra-cover where Kushagra gathers the ball.
36.3: Naman Dhir angles a flat length ball into leg-stump from round the wicket, prompting Will Young onto the back foot to nudge it toward deep backward square-leg.
36.4: Naman Dhir pitches on a length outside off for Michael Bracewell, whose firm drive sneaks straight through Kohli at extra-cover for a boundary.
47.2: Auqib Nabi watches Kyle Jamieson drive toward mid-off and scamper across, nearly undone by a desperate direct-hit at the bowler's end from Kohli that would have spelled curtains.
47.3: Auqib Nabi delivers as Kristian Clarke squeezes it towards mid-off to rotate the strike with a single.
47.4: Auqib Nabi bowls short and wide outside off, slapped by Kyle Jamieson straight to the Indian captain who misses a direct-hit from cover to grant another reprieve.
47.5: Auqib Nabi digs it in short, and Kristian Clarke cashes in with a top-edged pull that flies all the way to the fine leg boundary for four.
47.6: Auqib Nabi traps Kristian Clarke lbw with a pitched-up delivery around off that beats the flick and crashes plumb into the stumps, concluding a 22-run knock and sealing another breakthrough.
48.1: Arshdeep Singh fires down a low full toss around middle and leg, comfortably flicked away towards wide mid-on for a single.
48.2: Arshdeep Singh delivers on a good length around off, Matt Henry swings wildly too early, catching the leading edge that safely drops far short of Ruturaj charging in from deep point.
48.3: Arshdeep Singh digs it in short around off, Kyle Jamieson attacks the pull shot towards fine leg, adding two runs to the total.
48.4: Arshdeep Singh fires in a yorker length delivery attacking middle and leg, Kyle Jamieson squeezes it away off his pads toward the keeper for a leg bye.
48.5: Arshdeep Singh serves up a full toss, allowing Matt Henry to flick it cleanly away through the leg-side.
48.6: Arshdeep Singh completes the 49th over as Kyle Jamieson squeezes the ball into the off-side for a single.
49.1: Auqib Nabi rattles in a short delivery that climbs high over Kyle Jamieson's head, drawing a correct wide call from the umpire.
49.1: Auqib Nabi lands a yorker right in the slot, which Kyle Jamieson squeezes out toward long-on to comfortably collect a couple of runs.
49.2: Auqib Nabi pitches it up around off, inviting Kyle Jamieson to loft the ball cleanly over extra cover for two more runs.
49.3: Auqib Nabi targets a good length around middle and leg, leaving Kyle Jamieson swinging completely into empty air.
49.4: Auqib Nabi drops it on the shorter side around middle and leg, prompting Kyle Jamieson to flat-bat the ball toward long-on for a pair of runs.
49.5: Auqib Nabi capitalizes in the field to run out Matt Henry, ending his brief stay at two runs from two balls.
2.3: Matt Henry delivers a length ball outside off, and Ishan Kishan stands tall to bunt it towards the covers.
2.4: Matt Henry tests the width, prompting Ishan Kishan to flash hard at a cut that chops off the under-edge into the turf wide of the cordon.
2.5: Matt Henry fires in a fullish delivery, met by Ishan Kishan pushing firmly off the inner half back to the bowler.
2.6: Matt Henry charges in at 130kph, finding Ishan Kishan striding forward to solidly block the length ball into the off-side.
3.1: Kyle Jamieson sends down a 136kph outswinger just outside off, met by a stout forward defence from Ruturaj Gaikwad.
3.2: Kyle Jamieson targets the fifth-stump channel with another away-swinging delivery, allowing Ruturaj Gaikwad to leave it alone.
3.3: Kyle Jamieson digs it back of a length, and Ruturaj Gaikwad rides the bounce smoothly to tap it towards backward point.
3.4: Kyle Jamieson drifts a 136kph full delivery down the leg side past the chasing flick of Ruturaj Gaikwad, signaling a wide.
3.4: Kyle Jamieson strays too straight on a 134kph back-of-a-length delivery, allowing Ruturaj Gaikwad to tuck it away through square leg for a couple.
3.5: Kyle Jamieson extracts a hint of away nibble outside off, leaving Ruturaj Gaikwad beaten as his attempted pull is pulled back too late.
3.6: Kyle Jamieson pitches up outside off, enabling Ruturaj Gaikwad to drive past the diving backward point fielder as the third man scrambles across to mop it up.
4.1: Matt Henry angles one away on a length outside off, and Ishan Kishan slaps it straight towards the cover point fielder.
4.2: Matt Henry pins down Ishan Kishan with a 130kph delivery, drawing a sharp hop and defensive push to the bowler's left.
4.3: Matt Henry angles it in dangerously, catching an inside edge off Ishan Kishan's drive that narrowly misses the leg-stump.
4.4: Matt Henry watches Ishan Kishan aggressively advance down the track, meeting only an inside-half that lurches straight toward mid-on.
4.5: Ishan Kishan finally breaks the shackles against Matt Henry, pulling a 130kph short ball on the bounce to the deep fielder at backward square leg.
4.6: Ruturaj Gaikwad shuffles across his crease to dead-bat a fullish delivery from Matt Henry into the midwicket turf.
5.1: Kyle Jamieson targets the full channel outside off, tempting Ishan Kishan into a drive that catches a thick edge and scurries down to third man for a single.
15.6: Fisher fires in a searing short delivery that catches Kishan on the inside edge into his pad, culminating in a disastrously futile review.
16.1: Bracewell loops one full on middle with extravagant drift and turn, drawing Axar forward to prod toward backward point.
16.2: Bracewell drifts this one down the leg side, allowing Axar to step forward and whip it away toward deep square leg.
16.3: Bracewell tosses it full into middle, and Kishan leans forward to stroke it down the ground to long-on.
16.4: Bracewell darts a good-length ball into the pads, beating Axar's attempted flick well wide of leg stump.
16.5: Michael Bracewell hangs this up outside off, inviting Axar Patel forward to drive firmly toward the cover fielder.
16.6: Michael Bracewell flights this full delivery outside off, and Axar Patel lifts his drive safely into the open spaces toward long-off for a single.
17.1: Matthew Fisher finds the extra bounce from a hard length, squaring up Axar Patel who edges it straight to Finn Allen stationed comfortably at first slip.
17.2: Matthew Fisher darts this shorter delivery sharply back into middle and leg, evading Naman Dhir's attempted flick as it sails harmlessly down leg.
17.3: Matthew Fisher pulls back his length as the ball nips inward onto off stump, prompting Naman Dhir to work it off the back foot toward mid-wicket.
17.4: Matthew Fisher pitches this full and angles it into off, where Naman Dhir meets it forward for a crisp flick that finds the mid-on fielder.
17.5: Matthew Fisher serves up a full delivery outside off, and Naman Dhir times his forward drive cleanly straight into the hands of the mid-off fielder.
17.6: Matthew Fisher attacks middle with a full delivery, and Naman Dhir calls eagerly while flicking it past mid-on to scamper through for his opening run.
18.1: Michael Bracewell drops this flat delivery on a good length on off, allowing Naman Dhir to rock back and punch it down to long-on for a comfortable single.
18.2: Michael Bracewell tosses up a good length ball on off, and Ishan Kishan strides forward to dead-bat it toward the point fielder.
18.3: Michael Bracewell loops this full on middle, and Ishan Kishan gets right behind the line to push it firmly back toward the bowler.
18.4: Michael Bracewell delivers this one on a testing length, and Ishan Kishan works it away safely toward long-on to pick up a single.
25.1: Matthew Fisher steams in and hurries Gurnoor Brar with searing pace, forcing the bottom hand off the bat as the ball strikes the body while tucked toward mid-wicket.
25.2: Matthew Fisher attacks the crease again with venom, squeezing Gurnoor Brar on the tiptoes to fend the heavy ball safely down toward backward point.
25.3: Matthew Fisher slides one down the leg side past Gurnoor Brar's attempted flick, drawing the wide signal from the umpire.
25.3: Matthew Fisher drops it back of a length on middle, allowing Gurnoor Brar to step back, open the face, and steer a single past backward point.
25.4: Matthew Fisher bangs it in short outside leg, catching Arshdeep Singh's thick inside edge as he backs away to pull, narrowly missing the stumps on its way to Tim Seifert.
25.5: Matthew Fisher hunts Arshdeep Singh down the leg side with a sharp yorker, beating the flailing bat entirely as the batter fails to dig it out.
25.6: Matthew Fisher follows Arshdeep Singh far outside leg with a short delivery, prompting Tim Seifert to hurl himself to his right with an outstretched hand to claw away a certain boundary.
25.6: Matthew Fisher unleashes a searing yorker as Arshdeep Singh shuffles across, beating the attempted scoop completely by flashing just past the off-stump.
26.1: Matt Henry digs it in short and watches it sail over a ducking Gurnoor Brar, earning an immediate wide call for excessive height.
26.1: Matt Henry pitches it full outside off, leaving Gurnoor Brar lunging forward with static feet and beating him all ends up.
26.2: Matt Henry goes wide of the crease on a short-of-length delivery outside off, zipping past Gurnoor Brar's leaden-footed poke.
26.3: Matt Henry delivers a vicious short ball that slams directly into Gurnoor Brar's right arm, though the batter shakes it off instantly without needing the physio.
26.4: Matt Henry delivers the knockout blow as a full scrambled-seam ball sneaks beneath Gurnoor Brar's bat to shatter the base of off-stump, sealing a dominant 244-run victory for New Zealand.

preview.text: New Zealand play India at Bay Oval. In 54 recorded one-day meetings, New Zealand have won 23 and India 30. Sides batting first here usually make about 261 (13 recorded one-day matches). India won the toss and chose to bowl first. The forecast for the next 8 hours gives up to a 0 per cent chance of rain, at about 22 degrees.

summary.text: New Zealand won by 244 runs. NZ made 333-10, Will Young top-scoring with 125 off 108 balls; Axar Patel took 2 for 39. IND made 89-10, Ishan Kishan (wk) top-scoring with 27 off 53 balls; Matt Henry took 6 for 27. Sides batting first at Bay Oval usually make about 261.
